blindSummary: The highest measured killing rate in the country (24.7 per 100k trans women/yr) and a damning institutional response: after a mob of ~10 beat a trans couple outside a women's restroom in a town (May 2026), no alleged attacker was arrested and both victims were criminally charged, one booked into a men's facility. The municipality of the same county moved to criminalise trans restroom use by local ordinance — the sharpest instrument in a state/province with no whole-jurisdiction adult ban. A trans inmate was killed at the state's maximum-security prison (2024); killings continue into 2026. The state/province scores far below the encompassing country, i.e. local risk runs well above the country-wide average.
